hook: You wash the dishes before the dishwasher. Then you wash them again afterward. Tonight, the machine is going to have to explain itself.
Your dishwasher thinks you're the problem. Before you buy another one, let's put that accusation on trial.
Your dishwasher has been accused of wasting water and leaving dinner on the plates. Its defense? You loaded the evidence.
This bowl went through two cycles and came out dirty. The dishwasher wants the court to see how it got loaded.
Sam has put this bowl through the dishwasher twice. It still looks like dinner is in progress. You had one job. And you gave me an obstacle course.
